quest.title: Blind Loyalty, Reckless Courage
quest.description: The evidence of the Tenryou Commission's treason is in your hands. How will Kujou Sara's viewpoint change?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x650, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Return to the Grand Narukami Shrine and look for Yae Miko

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Lady Guuji. Here I am, as promised. Rest assured I came here alone and told no one about this trip.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I knew you would keep your promise, after all... I'm sure you've barely been able to take your mind off it these past few days — have you managed to get any sleep at all?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I—I... You're quite mistaken. I would never doubt the leaders of my clan.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: So. Where is your proof?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Ah, how wonderful. Everyone's keeping their promises today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You wouldn't believe what we had to go through to get our hands on this stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hand them to Sara. She can examine them for herself.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: What is this?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: ...I see this document bears the official seal of the head of the Kujou Clan. And it doesn't look like a forgery...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I don't understand... Not a single word about the resistance, Sangonomiya, or the situation on the front line...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: What about the soldiers who gave their lives on the front line, or the hardship endured by the people? Do they deserve no mention!?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Utter disregard for human life. Why would they want to hide it?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: For the sake of the Vision Hunt Decree, of course. Don't you think the Shogun might reconsider her policy if all of the things you just mentioned appeared in this report?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: So the Tenryou Commission... They are deliberately deceiving the Shogun?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Yes. Now... who else do you think might be benefiting from the Vision Hunt Decree?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I also have a confidential letter here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is a letter from the Tenryou Commission to the Fatui. The head of the Kujou Clan kept this a secret from the Shogun, too.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Well? The things you wanted to see, but also wished not to see, are here before you.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Surely... you aren't planning to turn a blind eye to them?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: So everything I've ever held on to... it's all... How could they... Argh!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: This betrayal is unforgivable... Takayuki, you've got some explaining to do!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kujou Sara seems pretty angry, huh. Looks like our Tenryou rebellion is successfully underway.

choices.text: The Shogun's Army is without a leader for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup yup, let's catch up with her.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Hold on, Traveler. There's something else we need to discuss.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Last time you entered the Plane of Euthymia, it was in front of the Statue of the Omnipresent God, correct?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Correct.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: You must find a way to recreate the circumstances of that day.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: If you can get the Raiden Shogun to "open her heart" to you once more before the Statue of the Omnipresent God, you will have the opportunity you need...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I will do my best.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Take this with you as a farewell gift.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is it?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: The omamori from the Grand Narukami Shrine are very potent indeed. I thought I'd put one aside for you.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Hehe, if you find yourself at your wits' end, take it out and see what happens. Maybe your prayers will be answered, and all your problems will disappear in the blink of an eye.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Or, if you ever think about me during your journey, take it out, won't you? Who knows, maybe I'll just end up appearing right in front of you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cut it out, Fox Lady. This isn't the time or place to be poking fun at the Traveler.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Hehehe... I'm sorry. Well then... time for you to face my hopeless fool of a friend. I'm counting on you.

choices.text: If we follow her, we might meet the Raiden Shogun.

talks.objective: Follow Kujou Sara to the Tenryou Commission Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: You followed me here? You've got guts, I'll give you that.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Since you are witnesses, I suppose I can shield you from arrest — at least until I have received an explanation from Takayuki.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: But... if it turns out that you have been deceptive in this matter, then not only will you be arrested immediately, but you'll also be charged with one more crime. Do I make myself clear?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Hmph. Good.

talks.objective: Follow Kujou Sara into the Tenryou Commission Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: Stop! Sara, have you gone insane!? How dare you disregard my orders!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: M—Master, I...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Go on, ask him! Don't let him intimidate you!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: ...Master Takayuki, I've seen the report to the throne and the letter to the Fatui... Please, tell me why!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: So this is how my documents went missing from headquarters? You stole them...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Should I take your words to mean that... these documents were not forgeries? They were really penned by your own hand?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Please tell me, Master, I need to know... Has the Tenryou Commission really... betrayed the Shogunate!?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: Hmph... Yes, I have dealings with the Fatui. And yes, the report you saw was penned by my hand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh, he just came right out and admitted it...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: The diplomats from Snezhnaya promised a very generous reward indeed... and all they requested of me in return was to see that the Vision Hunt Decree is upheld.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: For too long, the Kujou Clan's position has been coveted by so many. There is no shortage of clans who would tear us down at the first opportunity.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: So, when the chance arose to gain the backing of another powerful nation and crack down on our enemies at the same time...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: It appeared to me to be an excellent deal. I simply saw no need to inform you, Sara.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: But... you worship the Shogun. How can you betray her after all this time and act like it's nothing!?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: Betrayal? How can you call this a betrayal?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: The Fatui may think they are using me, but the reverse is true. What could they possibly hope to achieve?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: When the lightning strikes in Inazuma, they shall fall to their knees and tremble, paralyzed by fear and trepidation.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: After all...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: None can contend with the supreme power of the Almighty Raiden Shogun and the Musou no Hitotachi!

choices.text: His intention wasn't to betray the Raiden Shogun...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... he doesn't worship the Raiden Shogun herself, but her power as a warrior — especially the Musou no Hitotachi. In fact, he seems to be way too into it...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: But Master... what about loyalty?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Ever since I was adopted by the Kujou Clan, you taught me the importance of loyalty from servants to their superiors...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: But it's clear to me now that you wanted my loyalties to stop with the Kujou Clan. So you were scared that I would betray you one day?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: You hypocrite! Preaching about virtue just to mask your own wretched selfishness!

response.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
response.text: Selfishness? I am but safeguarding the eternity of the Kujou Clan. I'm quite sure the Almighty Shogun would be sympathetic to that, as would the former head of our clan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hate to say it, but his ego is getting in the way. If he thinks the Kujou Clan is a match for the Fatui, Paimon thinks he's in for a nasty surprise...

choices.text: There is no point trying to argue with him.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I've doubted the Vision Hunt Decree in the past. I asked myself, is this truly the correct thing to do? Even though it goes against what I know in my heart to be right?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: But I chose to obey the Shogun. For as long as she leads the way, who among us is qualified to judge between right and wrong when we have not yet reached the end of the path?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: But now I realize that the path of eternity is one without end, while this path... it has long since been defiled by your selfish ways.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: So, I'm going to tell the Shogun the truth about all this. If nothing else, my conscience will be clear!

response.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
response.text: Stubborn and futile...

response.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
response.text: Report to the Shogun if you so wish. The Kujou Clan's position is now unshakable, and nothing you can do will change this.

response.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
response.text: The Shogun is at <color=#00E1FFFF>Tenshukaku</color> receiving a Snezhnayan diplomat — the Harbinger by the name of "Signora."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Signora!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Signora's the one behind all this? Ugh, not her again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Way back in Ritou, Lady Hiiragi said something about the Kanjou Commissioner meeting with an arrogant-sounding woman... We should have known.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: A diplomat from Snezhnaya? Well! If she thinks she's leaving Inazuma in one piece, she's got another thing coming!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sara stormed off... Do you think she's gonna go barge into Tenshukaku right now?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Either way, we have a score to settle with Signora.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You can say that again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright then! Let's do this!

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: We shall go up to <color=#00E1FFFF>Tenshukaku</color>!

choices.text: Let's see what Kujou Sara thinks.
He's just over-confident in her power.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Mind yourself against the Raiden Shogun!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: That Guuji Yae... she's such an enigma.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Well, go on, time for you to face my hopeless fool of a friend. I'm counting on you.

dialogues.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
dialogues.text: I'll always treasure this water balloon...

dialogues.speaker: Youko
dialogues.text: Will you be here for the next Mikawa Flower Festival?

dialogues.speaker: Kappa
dialogues.text: I love playing with humans...

dialogues.speaker: Tomohiro
dialogues.text: The sales are rapidly increasing today. We're almost running out of stock, haha!
It'd be great if festivals like this are held every day!

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: I've been practicing for a really long time so that I'll actually scare people. I can finally take a break from that now...
